items.headline: Paul George Fined for Flopping in Celtics Debut
items.summary: Celtics forward Paul George has been hit with a $2,000 fine for flopping during Boston's season-opening game against the Detroit Pistons on Tuesday. George, who put up an impressive 38 points in his debut, was assessed the fine by the league office after review of the October 20th contest.

items.headline: Wizards Top Bucks
items.summary: The Washington Wizards secured a convincing 128-116 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks.

items.headline: Hawks Outlast Magic
items.summary: The Atlanta Hawks defeated the Orlando Magic in a high-scoring affair, 132-125.

items.headline: Hornets Sting Nets
items.summary: The Charlotte Hornets bested the Brooklyn Nets with a final score of 110-103.

items.headline: Raptors Dominate Bulls
items.summary: The Toronto Raptors delivered a dominant performance, routing the Chicago Bulls 135-92.

items.headline: Pacers Edge Pelicans
items.summary: The Indiana Pacers narrowly defeated the New Orleans Pelicans 123-120.

items.headline: Wolves Beat Heat
items.summary: The Minnesota Timberwolves secured a commanding 131-106 victory over the Miami Heat.

items.headline: Grizzlies Down Jazz
items.summary: The Memphis Grizzlies took down the Utah Jazz with a final score of 123-103.

items.headline: Rockets Soar Past Mavs
items.summary: The Houston Rockets secured a solid 128-110 win against the Dallas Mavericks.

items.headline: Blazers Rout Suns
items.summary: The Portland Trail Blazers delivered a decisive 124-83 rout of the Phoenix Suns.

items.headline: Lakers Defeat Warriors
items.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers routed the visiting Golden State Warriors 127-105.

items.headline: Clippers Beat Kings
items.summary: The LA Clippers defeated the Sacramento Kings 121-96.

items.headline: Anthony Edwards Explodes for 45 Points
items.summary: MIN's Anthony Edwards put on a scoring clinic, dropping 45 points to lead the Timberwolves past the Heat.

items.headline: Paul George's Stellar Celtics Debut
items.summary: Paul George had a stunning 38-point performance in his Boston Celtics debut against the Detroit Pistons.

items.headline: Luka Doncic Leads Lakers with 28 Points
items.summary: LAL's Luka Doncic scored 28 points to help the Lakers secure a decisive victory over the Golden State Warriors.

items.headline: Walker Kessler's Perfect Debut for Lakers
items.summary: In his Los Angeles debut, Walker Kessler added 26 points on a perfect 12-of-12 shooting from the field for the Lakers.

items.headline: Damian Lillard Shines in Return to Blazers
items.summary: Damian Lillard shined in his return to the Portland Trail Blazers, contributing to their dominant win over the Phoenix Suns.

items.headline: Lakers' $500 Fine System Encourages Half-Court Shots
items.summary: JJ Redick revealed the Lakers' $500 fine system, which he admitted inadvertently instilled confidence in Luka Doncic's ability to knock down half-court shots.

items.headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Heat's Embarrassing Loss
items.summary: Heat forward Giannis Antetokounmpo attributed Miami's embarrassing 25-point loss to the Timberwolves to a lack of trust and effort from the team.
